preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 668 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 100 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length n is an integer between 2 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(sorted(p) == list(range(1, len(p) + 1)) for p in perms)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the input array p is a valid permutation of length n containing distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(p_prime) == n and sorted(p_prime) == list(range(1, n + 1)) for p_prime, n in zip(output_perms, ns))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output array p' is a valid permutation of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(p_prime != p for p_prime, p in zip(output_perms, perms))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output permutation p' is different from the input permutation p.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted([p_prime[i] + p_prime[i+1] for i in range(len(p_prime)-1)]) == sorted([p[i] + p[i+1] for i in range(len(p)-1)]) for p_prime, p in zip(output_perms, perms))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the fingerprint of p' (sorted adjacent sums) is identical to the fingerprint of p.
